avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction may reduce topiramate levels and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative herbal products

avoid_supplements.name: Phenobarbital
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Enhanced metabolism of topiramate via CYP3A4 induction; reduced anticonvulsant efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid or require dose adjustment and therapeutic drug monitoring

caution_supplements.name: Ginkgo biloba
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential additive anticonvulsant effects; minor CYP3A4 interaction
caution_supplements.action: Monitor seizure control; report changes in seizure frequency

caution_supplements.name: Calcium supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: May reduce topiramate absorption if taken simultaneously
caution_supplements.action: Separate dosing by 2+ hours; monitor seizure control

caution_supplements.name: Magnesium supplements
caution_supplements.action: Separate dosing by 2+ hours; maintain consistent timing

avoid_foods.name: Alcohol
avoid_foods.mechanism: Additive CNS depression; increased risk of sedation, cognitive impairment, and ataxia
avoid_foods.action: Avoid alcohol completely or limit to minimal intake; counsel on impaired judgment/motor function

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase topiramate exposure
caution_foods.action: Limit consumption; monitor for increased adverse effects

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May delay ER formulation absorption timing
caution_foods.action: Take consistently with or without food; maintain routine

monitoring_notes: Monitor for cognitive/CNS effects, especially with alcohol or other CNS depressants. Assess renal function periodically, as topiramate is primarily renally eliminated and carbonic anhydrase inhibition may affect electrolytes and hydration status. Watch for metabolic acidosis and hypokalemia.
